message.content:
I don’t have real‑time clock access, so I can’t tell you the exact current time in New York City right now.  
If you need the precise time, you can:

1. **Check your device’s clock** – most smartphones and computers automatically adjust for the local time zone.  
2. **Use a timezone converter** – sites like [timeanddate.com](https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/) or the “World Clock” feature on Google will show the current time in New York (Eastern Time, UTC‑5 or UTC‑4 depending on daylight‑saving).  
3. **Ask a smart assistant** – Siri, Google Assistant, Alexa, etc., can give you the current time instantly.

If you’d like a quick example of how to get the time programmatically (e.g., in Python), let me know!
